AbstractConfigFilter from pac4j should implement jakarta.servlet.Filter in the updated version, making the addFilter call valid when Dropwizard is also aligned with Jakarta. Minimal changes: replace javax servlet imports with jakarta servlet imports. No method signatures or other code need alteration.
